description: Complete a basic KYC verification by providing required documents and information.

requirements.name: Proof of Identity
requirements.description: A valid government-issued ID (e.g. passport, driver's license) or national ID card.
requirements.validation_hints: ID must be issued within the last 5 years, names must match exactly.

requirements.name: Proof of Address
requirements.description: A utility bill or bank statement showing your current address.
requirements.validation_hints: Document must be dated within the last 3 months, names must match exactly.
